deadlines.label: Rolling: non-competitive program without proposal submission deadlines; concept proposals may be submitted at any time
deadlines.quote: The Conservancy's Community and Economic Enhancement Grant Program is a non- competitive program without proposal submission deadlines.

caps.what: indirect costs, percent of grant-funded direct costs for personnel services and operating expenses (general)

match.quote: Consistent with provisions of Proposition 68, all applicants are encouraged to provide cost share to support their project

award.quote: Grantees will receive funding only during the Grant Funding Term, generally three years, during which time grantees may incur and be reimbursed for grant-related expenses.

criteria.name: 1. Project Design
criteria.quote: Are the project's purpose, goals, deliverables, and schedule clear? Is the project well designed to meet the needs that the project addresses?

criteria.name: 2. Public Benefits
criteria.quote: Will the project provide multiple tangible, enduring, public benefits with a high likelihood of being realized? Does the project have reasonable performance measurements and a clear plan for tracking them?

criteria.name: 3. Alignment with State and Other Priorities
criteria.quote: 3. Alignment with State and Other Priorities Does the project align with priorities identified in the following?:

criteria.name: 4. Project Readiness
criteria.quote: Is the project ready to proceed promptly if funded? For planning projects, will planning activities advance the project toward implementation in a timely manner?

criteria.name: 5. Community and Institutional Support
criteria.quote: Does the project have public and relevant institutional support at the local, regional, State, or federal scale?

criteria.name: 6. Cost Share
criteria.quote: 6. Cost Share Is cost share provided for this project?

criteria.name: 7. Project Budget
criteria.quote: 7. Project Budget Is the budget adequate and reasonable for the project? Are costs clearly identified and justified?

criteria.name: 8. Project Team
criteria.quote: Does the project team have sufficient experience and capacity to implement the project and to manage a State grant? Have necessary partnerships been developed?

criteria.name: 9. Long-Term Management
criteria.quote: For implementation projects, is a plan clearly identified for long-term management and sustainability of the project for a minimum of 15 years?

eligibility.item: Eligible applicants: California public agencies (cities, counties, districts, joint powers authorities, State agencies, California public colleges and universities) and nonprofit organizations qualified to do business in California with 501(c)(3) exempt status
eligibility.quote: California public agencies. California public agencies include any city, county, district, or joint powers authority; State agencies; or California public colleges and universities.

eligibility.item: An eligible nonprofit must have among its principal charitable purposes land, environmental, wildlife, cultural/historical preservation or public-land enjoyment purposes
eligibility.quote: An eligible nonprofit organization has among its principal charitable purposes preservation of land for scientific, recreational, scenic, or open-space opportunities

eligibility.item: Project must be bond eligible: construction, acquisition, or long-term improvement of capital assets with an expected useful life of at least 15 years
eligibility.quote: General obligation bond funds must be spent on the construction, acquisition, or long-term improvement of capital assets. Capital assets are defined as tangible property that has an expected useful life of no less than 15 years

eligibility.item: Project must be within or benefit the Delta and Suisun Marsh (outside only if the Board makes the Delta Reform Act Section 32360(g) findings)
eligibility.quote: The Conservancy will fund projects within or benefitting the Delta and Suisun Marsh as defined in PRC Section 85058.

eligibility.item: Project must provide significant benefit to the Delta
eligibility.quote: To be eligible to receive a grant from the Conservancy under this program, projects must: Provide significant benefit to the Delta.

eligibility.item: Project must be consistent with the program objectives and priorities in the Guidelines
eligibility.quote: Show consistency with program objectives and priorities as defined in these Guidelines.

eligibility.item: Project must be consistent with the Conservancy's mission and enabling legislation
eligibility.quote: Show consistency with the Conservancy's mission and enabling legislation.

eligibility.item: Project must align with the Delta Plan
Project must comply with Proposition 68, State General Obligation Bond Law, and other applicable State and federal laws
eligibility.quote: Comply with Proposition 68, State General Obligation Bond Law (GOV Sec. 16727), and other applicable State and federal laws.

eligibility.item: Planning projects that do not advance an eligible implementation project are ineligible
eligibility.quote: Planning projects that do not advance an eligible implementation project.

eligibility.item: Projects dictated by a legal settlement or mandated to address a violation of or order to comply with a law or regulation are ineligible
eligibility.quote: Projects dictated by a legal settlement or mandated to address a violation of, or an order (citation) to comply with, a law or regulation.

eligibility.item: Projects that subsidize or decrease the mitigation obligations of any party are ineligible
eligibility.quote: Projects that subsidize or decrease the mitigation obligations of any party.

eligibility.item: Implementation projects must complete CEQA compliance before grant award
eligibility.quote: NOTE: For implementation projects, California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) compliance must be completed prior to grant award.

eligibility.item: Land acquisitions must be from a willing seller, comply with public-agency acquisition law, and not exceed fair market value
eligibility.quote: Property acquired through this program must be purchased from a willing seller and in compliance with current laws governing acquisition of real property by public agencies for an amount not to exceed fair market value

requiredDocuments.item: Concept Proposal (Community and Economic Enhancement Grant Program Concept Proposal Form)
requiredDocuments.quote: Applicants must submit a concept proposal using the Community and Economic Enhancement Grant Program Concept Proposal Form.

requiredDocuments.item: Commitment letters from cost share partners confirming the dollar amount committed, including in-kind (if the applicant states a cost share component)
requiredDocuments.quote: Applicants stating that they have a cost share component must provide commitment letters from cost share partners before a proposal is recommended for funding

requiredDocuments.item: Project budget with costs clearly identified and justified
requiredDocuments.quote: Is the budget adequate and reasonable for the project? Are costs clearly identified and justified?

requiredDocuments.item: California Conservation Corps / CALCC consultation (Corps' Proposition 68 Consultation Process form) for implementation projects with a site improvement component
requiredDocuments.quote: all implementation projects that involve a site improvement component shall consult with representatives of both the California Conservation Corps and California Association of Local Conservation Corps (Corps)
